title: 2559. Count Vowel Strings in Ranges

examples.explanation: The strings starting and ending with a vowel are "aba", "ece", "aa" and "e". The answer to the query [0,2] is 2 (strings "aba" and "ece"). to query [1,4] is 3 (strings "ece", "aa", "e"). to query [1,1] is 0. We return [2,3,0].
Every string satisfies the conditions, so we return [3,2,1].
